name: Feral Scavenger (Legendary Hunter Archetype)
body:
Some rangers are merely survivors who have learned the right lessons quickly enough to thrive. Alone, under-equipped, and desperately clinging to survival, the feral scavenger has learned the first ranger rule: adapt or die.

Weapon and Armor Proficiencies

The feral scavenger gains proficiency with simple weapons only. They are not proficient with any armor or with shields. This modifies weapon and armor proficiencies.

AC Bonus (Ex)

When unarmored and unencumbered, the feral scavenger adds their Wisdom bonus (if any) to their AC and their CMD, and they gain a +1 bonus to AC and CMD for every four class levels they possess.

These bonuses to AC apply even against touch attacks or when the feral scavenger is flat-footed. They lose these bonuses when they are immobilized or helpless, when they wear any armor, when they carry a shield, or when they carry a medium or heavy load.

Tooth and Nail (Ex)

The feral scavenger is used to fighting with simple weapons, and with their bare hands. At 1st level, they gain the unchained monk’s unarmed strike class feature, dealing damage as an unchained monk of their feral scavenger level.

This ability replaces predation.

Use of Weapons (Ex)

The feral scavenger has learned to use whatever is at hand to defend himself. They gain the feats Catch Off-Guard and Nature’s Weapons as bonus feats, even if they do not qualify for them. The feral scavenger may do damage with improvised weapons equal to their unarmed damage.

Whenever the feral scavenger gains a combat feat that requires that they choose a specific weapon or weapon group, they may choose all simple and improved weapons and unarmed as a single entity. At 1st level, they gain the Weapon Focus feat for all simple and improved weapons and unarmed strikes as a bonus feat.

Feral scavenger Talents

The feral scavenger adds the following to the list of talents they may choose their ranger talents from:

Bone Blades (Su)

The feral scavenger can cause hardened blades of bone to extend from their hands, forearms, and possibly their feet as well. Their unarmed attacks threaten a critical hit on a roll of 19 or 20 (this may be modified by effects such as the Improved Critical feat), and they may do bludgeoning, slashing and piercing damage with them.

Feral Strike (Su)

(4th level)

As a swift action, the feral scavenger can imbue their weapons (natural, improvised, or otherwise) and their unarmed attacks with a fraction of their feral power. For 1 minute, their weapons have a +1 enhancement bonus to attack and damage rolls. For every five class levels they possess, this bonus increases by +1. to a maximum of +5 at 20th level.
